name: What is a fourplex investment property?

mainEntity.name: What is a fourplex investment property?

acceptedAnswer.text: A fourplex investment property is a residential building divided into four separate housing units. Each unit can be rented out to different tenants, generating multiple streams of rental income from a single property. This type of investment is often attractive to investors seeking to diversify their portfolio and potentially achieve higher cash flow compared to single-family homes, though it also involves managing more tenants and units.
acceptedAnswer.description: A fourplex is a single property with four separate housing units, offering multiple rental income streams.
